scripts.text:
[Jet]
Every god never grows old
Because of beautiful
Goddess, Idun.
Keeper of the apples of youth
Goddess of immortality.
scripts.translation:
[杰特]
诸神之所以永不衰老，
皆因美丽的伊顿女神。
她是青春之苹果的守护者，
也是永生女神。

scripts.text:
[Jet]
Ooh, you're an Archer?
There was a time when I too
was an Archer. But I've changed jobs, so now I entertain the masses with my songs and humor.
scripts.translation:
[杰特]
噢，你是弓箭手？
曾经我也是一名弓箭手。不过我转职了，现在用歌声和幽默逗乐大家。

scripts.text:
[Jet]
Ooh...!
You're...!

[Jet]
You look bored...
Is life really that
mundane and tiresome?
Then... I shall make
you laugh...
scripts.translation:
[杰特]
你看起来很无聊...
生活真的那么
枯燥乏味吗？
那...我就让你
笑一笑吧...

scripts.text:
[Jet]
Ooh...!
Hello, hello!
Wouldn't it be
nice if we could
perform together
one of these days?
scripts.translation:
[杰特]
噢...！
你好，你好！
要是有一天我们能
一起表演，
那该多好啊？

scripts.text:
[Jet]
Speaking of which...
Let me tell you a joke!
Trust me, it's hilarious~
^333333*Ahem*^000000
scripts.translation:
[杰特]
说到这个...
让我给你讲个笑话！
相信我，很好笑的~
^333333*咳咳*^000000

scripts.text:
[Jet]
A termite walks
into a bar and says,
'Is the bar tender here?'
Hahahahaha!
Bwehehehehe!
scripts.translation:
[杰特]
一只白蚁走进酒吧说：
“这里有补给吗？”
哈哈哈哈！
嘿嘿嘿嘿！

scripts.text:
[Jet]
Hahaha~!
Goodness,
I'm funny!
Now, you try!
Come on, make
up a joke~!
scripts.translation:
[杰特]
哈哈~！
天哪，
我真幽默！
现在，轮到你了！
来，编个笑话~！

scripts.text: A joke, eh?
scripts.translation: 笑话，是吗？

scripts.text:
[Jet]
Oh...
My...
God...

[Jet]
That was the greatest
joke I've ever heard in my
life! You really have a natural
talent for showmanship! You
just have to become a Bard!
scripts.translation:
[杰特]
这是我这辈子听过的
最好笑的笑话！你天生
就有表演天赋！你
只要成为诗人就好了！

scripts.text: Scream!
scripts.translation: 尖叫！

scripts.text:
[Jet]
W-Wow...
I don't know why, but that was truly amazing. You must have
what it takes to become a Dancer...
scripts.translation:
[杰特]
哇...
我不知道为什么，但这真的很棒。你肯定
有成为舞娘的潜质...

scripts.text:
[Jet]
But before any of that, you've got to get rid of the Archer look, no?
scripts.translation:
[杰特]
不过在那之前，你得先摆脱弓箭手的形象，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Jet]
Actually I'm a member of
the ^3131FFArcher's Guild^000000 'Icarus' which is to the ^3131FFleft of the job change office^000000. You should be able to
learn a lot from there.
scripts.translation:
[杰特]
其实我是^3131FF弓箭手公会^000000“伊卡洛斯”的成员，就在^3131FF转职办公室的左边^000000。你应该能在那里学到很多东西。

scripts.text:
[Jet]
Now now, go learn
everything and change
jobs so that you can
come play with me!
scripts.translation:
[杰特]
好了好了，去学点东西，
转职吧，这样你
就能来陪我玩了！

scripts.text:
[Jet]
Let's see...
I've been working
on a new joke here,
but I could use some
feedback. You ready?
scripts.translation:
[杰特]
让我看看...
我最近正在
创作一个新笑话，
但需要一些
反馈。你准备好了吗？

scripts.text:
[Jet]
What did the male
Merchant say to the
dancing Isis? Give up?
scripts.translation:
[杰特]
那个男性商人对
正在跳舞的蛇女伊丝说了什么？
猜不到？

scripts.text:
[Jet]
'Mammonite!'
Get it? 'Cuz he
throws money at her
and the word Mammonite
sounds-- wait. It's not funny
if I have to explain it, huh?
scripts.translation:
[杰特]
“金钱攻击！”
懂吗？因为他
向她扔钱，而且金钱攻击这个词听起来——等等。如果我要解释就不好笑了，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Jet]
^333333*Ahem*^000000
These are the
famous last words
of a mafia hit man...
scripts.translation:
[杰特]
^333333*咳咳*^000000
这是黑帮杀手
最后的遗言...

scripts.text:
[Jet]
'Who put the
violin in this
violin case?!'
Bwahahahahahahah!
Get the joke?
scripts.translation:
[杰特]
“谁把小提琴
放进这个
琴盒里的？！”
哇哈哈哈哈哈！
懂这个笑话吗？

scripts.text:
Archer Job Change Office ---> 
 <--- Icarus
scripts.translation:
弓箭手转职处 --->
<--- 伊卡洛斯

scripts.text:
[Master Kavaruk]
Hello, young one.
I am Master Kavaruk
of the Icarus Archer Guild.
I bid you welcome.
scripts.translation:
[卡瓦鲁克大师]
你好，年轻人。
我是伊卡洛斯弓箭手公会的
卡瓦鲁克大师。
欢迎你。

scripts.text: Ask about 'Icarus.'
scripts.translation: 询问关于“伊卡洛斯”的事。

scripts.text: Ask about recent news.
scripts.translation: 询问最近的新闻。

scripts.text: Talk about Archers.
scripts.translation: 聊聊弓箭手。

scripts.text:
[Master Kavaruk]
Have you ever
heard the story
of Icarus before?
scripts.translation:
[卡瓦鲁克大师]
你以前听说过
伊卡洛斯的故事吗？

scripts.text:
[Master Kavaruk]
Icarus was a brave young man who flew through the sky using wings held together by beeswax. Out of curiosity, he flew too close to the sun, his wings melted, and he fell to his death.
scripts.translation:
[卡瓦鲁克大师]
伊卡洛斯是一个勇敢的年轻人，他使用蜂蜡粘合的翅膀在天空中飞翔。出于好奇，他飞得太靠近太阳，翅膀融化了，最终坠亡。

scripts.text:
[Master Kavaruk]
Although his is a tragic story, Icarus had a courageous heart
that we should look up to as
our standard.
scripts.translation:
[卡瓦鲁克大师]
虽然这是一个悲剧，但伊卡洛斯拥有我们应当效仿的
勇敢之心。

scripts.text:
[Master Kavaruk]
The members of our guild are those who not only wish to be brave, but to reach out for our dreams like Icarus did. Our members are aspiring Archers, former Archers and current Archers.
scripts.translation:
[卡瓦鲁克大师]
我们公会的成员不仅渴望勇敢，更渴望像伊卡洛斯那样去追逐梦想。我们的成员包括立志成为弓箭手的人、前弓箭手以及现任弓箭手。

scripts.text:
[Master Kavaruk]
In fact, a few of our
members specialize in
capturing the fascination
of those watching with their
graceful dances, just like you.
scripts.translation:
[卡瓦鲁克大师]
事实上，我们公会中
有几位成员擅长
用优雅的舞姿
吸引观众的目光，
就像你一样。

scripts.text:
[Master Kavaruk]
In fact, a few of our members
are highly skilled in singing and entertaining their allies, much in the same way you do.
scripts.translation:
[卡瓦鲁克大师]
事实上，我们公会中
有几位成员擅长
歌唱和娱乐盟友，
和你一样。

scripts.text:
[Master Kavaruk]
If you'd like to become an Archer, why don't you go around and learn
a few things about the profession? I'm sure you'll be able to hear plenty of stories around here.
scripts.translation:
[卡瓦鲁克大师]
如果你想成为弓箭手，不妨四处走走，了解一下这个职业。我相信你在这里能听到不少故事。

scripts.text:
[Master Kavaruk]
Since you're an Archer, you might
benefit from going around and listening to everyone else's battle experiences. Becoming familiar with different fight scenarios will help you in the future.
scripts.translation:
[卡瓦鲁克大师]
既然你是弓箭手，不妨四处走走，听听其他人的战斗经验。熟悉不同的战斗场景会对你的未来有所帮助。

scripts.text:
[Master Kavaruk]
[Master Kavaruk]
Arpesto is waiting
outside. Since he's a
veteran hunter, he can
be of great help to you.
scripts.translation:
[卡瓦鲁克大师]
阿尔佩斯托正在外面等候。既然他是一位经验丰富的猎人，他一定能对你很有帮助。

scripts.text:
[Master Kavaruk]
They happen to know a lot of information about jobs related to Archers. Why don't you speak to them and learn more about
these other jobs?
scripts.translation:
[卡瓦鲁克大师]
他们恰好知道很多关于与弓箭手相关职业的信息。不妨和他们对话，了解更多关于这些其他职业的事情？

scripts.text:
[Master Kavaruk]
...But I don't seem to see
any of them around here right now. They never seem to remain in one
place for very long. Still, I'm sure of them will turn up here
one of these days.
scripts.translation:
[卡瓦鲁克大师]
...但我似乎没看到他们在这里。他们似乎从不长时间停留在一个地方。不过，我相信他们中会有人某天出现在这里。

scripts.text:
[Master Kavaruk]
...But I don't seem to see any of them around here right now. They always wander wherever the wind takes them, but I'm sure one of them will wander back here one
of these days.
scripts.translation:
[卡瓦鲁克大师]
...但我似乎没看到他们在这里。他们总是随风飘荡，但我相信他们中会有人某天回到这里。

scripts.text:
[Master Kavaruk]
Oh, it's a good thing
you're here, {0}.
I've just received request for support from the Alchemist
Guild in Al De Baran.
scripts.translation:
[卡瓦鲁克大师]
哦，你来得正好，{0}。
我刚收到艾尔帕兰炼金术士公会
发出的支援请求。

scripts.text:
[Master Kavaruk]
Hmmm...
..........

[Master Kavaruk]
Find Arthail
of the Wind for me.
He must be somewhere
in Prontera...
scripts.translation:
[卡瓦鲁克大师]
帮我找找风之阿尔塞尔。
他应该在普隆德拉的某个地方...

scripts.text:
[Master Kavaruk]
Hmmm, I see. Thank you
for bringing me the news. As Arthail has said, I shall wait until he has more news for me.
You should also train and prepare for the future as well.
scripts.translation:
[卡瓦鲁克大师]
嗯，我明白了。谢谢你告诉我这个消息。正如阿尔塞尔所说，我会等到他有更多消息再告诉我。
你也应该好好训练，为未来做好准备。

scripts.text:
[Master Kavaruk]
I don't know...
Recently, I haven't heard any noteworthy news. For now, the warmth of the sun seems to be protecting the peace here.
scripts.translation:
[卡瓦鲁克大师]
我不知道...
最近，我没有听到什么值得注意的消息。目前看来，阳光的温暖似乎正在守护着这里的和平。

scripts.text:
[Master Kavaruk]
They've been taking care
of a Flora field as a way of supplying their funds, but recently some stray cats seem to have been destroying the plants there.
scripts.translation:
[卡瓦鲁克大师]
他们一直在照料芙罗拉田，以此作为资金来源，但最近似乎有些流浪猫在破坏那里的植物。

scripts.text:
[Master Kavaruk]
Although the Alchemists have been using Alchemy to summon the Flora again to keep the field running, it's causing a strain on their resources.
scripts.translation:
[卡瓦鲁克大师]
虽然炼金术士们一直在使用融合试验技能重新召唤芙罗拉以维持田地运作，但这给他们的资源造成了很大的负担。

scripts.text:
[Master Kavaruk]
They are willing to give rewards for bringing materials such as ^3131FFManeater Blossoms^000000 and ^3131FFStems^000000 which will help them restore
their Flora.
scripts.translation:
[卡瓦鲁克大师]
他们愿意为提供^3131FF噬人树花^000000和^3131FF茎^000000等材料的人给予奖励，这将有助于他们恢复芙罗拉。

scripts.text:
[Master Kavaruk]
If you're interested, it would probably be best to speak to the Alchemist Guild member who is waiting to hear from us at the ^3131FFshop next to the road south of Icarus^000000.
scripts.translation:
[卡瓦鲁克大师]
如果你感兴趣，最好去和那位正在等待我们消息的炼金术士公会成员对话，他在^3131FF伊卡鲁斯南侧道路旁的商店^000000。

scripts.text: Is something the matter?
scripts.translation: 出什么事了吗？

scripts.text:
[Master Kavaruk]
Actually, we have a problem.
The position of master seems to have a lot of power, but I always need to remain here. I don't have the luxury of being able to leave my post.
scripts.translation:
[卡瓦鲁克大师]
其实，我们遇到了一个问题。
虽然大师这个职位拥有很大的权力，但我必须一直留在这里。我没有离开岗位的余裕。

scripts.text:
[Master Kavaruk]
I asked a member of Icarus to
wander about the Rune-Midgarts Kingdom and gather news and information about what has been going on recently.
scripts.translation:
[卡瓦鲁克大师]
我让伊卡鲁斯的一名成员在卢恩·米德加兹王国四处游荡，收集最近发生的消息和资讯。

scripts.text:
[Master Kavaruk]
He has been sending me letters containing detailed information, but all of a sudden, I've lost contact with him. I'm concerned over what may have happened.
scripts.translation:
[卡瓦鲁克大师]
他一直在给我寄信件，里面包含详细的信息，但突然之间，我失去了与他的联系。我很担心他可能发生了什么。

scripts.text:
[Master Kavaruk]
Would you please go find
^3131FFArthail of the Wind^000000 for me? Although he doesn't like people, I've ordered for him to wander within the crowds to gather information.
scripts.translation:
[卡瓦鲁克大师]
请你帮我找找^3131FF风之阿尔塞尔^000000好吗？虽然他不喜欢与人接触，但我命令他在人群中游荡以收集资讯。

scripts.text:
[Master Kavaruk]
Please find out if he is all right and help him with whatever he
may need. In the meantime, I will be waiting to hear from you. Thank you very much.
scripts.translation:
[卡瓦鲁克大师]
请确认他是否安好，并帮助他解决任何他可能需要的事情。在此期间，我会等待你的消息。非常感谢。

scripts.text:
[Master Kavaruk]
But if I hear of
any interesting rumors,
I will let you know.
scripts.translation:
[卡瓦鲁克大师]
但如果我听到任何有趣的传闻，我会告诉你的。

scripts.text:
[Master Kavaruk]
[Master Kavaruk]
Arpesto is waiting
outside. Since he's a
veteran hunter, he can
be of great help to you.
scripts.translation:
[卡瓦鲁克大师]
阿尔佩斯托正在外面等候。既然他是一位经验丰富的猎人，他一定能对你很有帮助。

scripts.text:
[Master Kavaruk]
Although you may not be able
to directly apply archery related knowledge, it's a good idea to understand the capabilities of
your Archer allies.
scripts.translation:
[卡瓦鲁克大师]
虽然你可能无法直接应用与弓箭手相关的知识，但了解你的弓箭手盟友的能力是个好主意。

scripts.text:
[Master Kavaruk]
Ah...
So are you
interested in
becoming an Archer?
scripts.translation:
[卡瓦鲁克大师]
啊...
那么你是
对成为弓箭手
感兴趣吗？

scripts.text:
[Master Kavaruk]
Although I can't deny that you're an expert, I suppose it is a good idea to review the basics of archery from time to time. Would you like to try some refresher training?
scripts.translation:
[卡瓦鲁克大师]
虽然我不能否认你是专家，但时不时复习一下弓箭手的基础知识是个好主意。你想试试一些复习训练吗？

scripts.text:
[Master Kavaruk]
As an Archer, I can see that you'd want to make sure that you have a strong grasp on the fundamentals
of our job. Would you like some specialized instruction?
scripts.translation:
[卡瓦鲁克大师]
作为一名弓箭手，我能看出你希望确保自己牢固掌握我们职业的基础。你想接受一些专门指导吗？

scripts.text:
[Master Kavaruk]
Hmm...?
What are you still
doing here? Go to the
hills west of Icarus and
talk to ^3131FFSeisner^000000 to begin your special training.
scripts.translation:
[卡瓦鲁克大师]
嗯...？
你还在这里做什么？去伊卡鲁斯西侧的山丘，和^3131FF赛斯纳^000000对话以开始你的特殊训练。

scripts.text:
[Master Kavaruk]
So {0},
Did you have a good experience? Learning theory alone is never too enjoyable, but it is necessary.
scripts.translation:
[卡瓦鲁克大师]
那么{0}，
你体验得如何？仅学习理论从来都不是一件令人愉快的事，但它是必要的。

scripts.text:
[Master Kavaruk]
Reidin Corse is just outside of this building. Didn't you see him on your way in?
scripts.translation:
[卡瓦鲁克大师]
雷丁·科斯就在这个建筑外面。你进来的时候没看到他吗？

scripts.text:
[Master Kavaruk]
You're great
just as you are now.
Still, if you feel like you need something, speak to any of the guild members and listen to their life experiences.
scripts.translation:
[卡瓦鲁克大师]
你现在的样子就很棒了。
不过，如果你觉得还需要什么，可以和公会的任何成员对话，听听他们的生活经历。

scripts.text:
[Master Kavaruk]
How would you like
some specialized instruction to learn more about the Archer job?
scripts.translation:
[卡瓦鲁克大师]
你想接受一些专门指导，以更深入地了解弓箭手这个职业吗？

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 否

scripts.text:
[Master Kavaruk]
Ah yes. Well then, please
take this message over to ^3131FFSeisner^000000 who is in the Training Grounds west of Icarus.
scripts.translation:
[卡瓦鲁克大师]
啊，是的。那么，请把这封信带给^3131FF赛斯纳^000000，她在伊卡鲁斯西侧的训练场。

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou've received
Kavaruk's message
for Seisner.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你收到了
卡瓦鲁克给赛斯纳的信。^000000

scripts.text:
[Master Kavaruk]
Seisner is very diligent,
composed, intelligent and
extremely capable. I believe
that you can learn much from her.
scripts.translation:
[卡瓦鲁克大师]
赛斯纳非常勤奋、沉稳、聪明且能力出众。我相信你能从她身上学到很多东西。

scripts.text:
[Master Kavaruk]
Ah, I see. Well,
Icarus will always welcome
you with open arms. If you
ever change your mind, feel
free to come back.
scripts.translation:
[卡瓦鲁克大师]
啊，我明白了。伊卡鲁斯的大门永远向你敞开。如果你改变主意，随时欢迎回来。

scripts.text:
[Master Kavaruk]
Now it is time to experience the principles you've just learned firsthand. Go speak to ^3131FFReidin Corse^000000, who is just outside of this building, and he'll tell you about the different skills.
scripts.translation:
[卡瓦鲁克大师]
现在，是时候亲身体验你刚学到的原则了。去和^3131FF雷丁·科斯^000000对话，他就在这个建筑外面，他会向你介绍不同的技能。

scripts.text:
[Master Kavaruk]
Still, there's no need for you to do any field training since only Archers can actually participate
in that.
scripts.translation:
[卡瓦鲁克大师]
不过，你不需要进行实地训练，因为只有弓箭手才能参加那种训练。

scripts.text:
You're great
just as you are now.
Still, if you feel like you need something, speak to any of the guild members and listen to their life experiences.
scripts.translation:
你现在的样子就很棒了。
不过，如果你觉得还需要什么，可以和公会的任何成员对话，听听他们的生活经历。

scripts.text:
[Reidin Corse]
[Reidin Corse]
Why are you carrying
so much stuff? You better put everything you don't need into Kafra Storage.
scripts.translation:
[雷丁·科斯]
[雷丁·科斯]
你为什么带这么多东西？最好把不需要的东西都放进卡普拉仓库。

scripts.text:
[Reidin Corse]
Hey, you're carrying an
awful lot of stuff. You ought
to put some of your things
into Kafra Storage...
scripts.translation:
[雷丁·科斯]
嘿，你带了好多东西啊。你应该把一些东西放进卡普拉仓库...

scripts.text:
[Reidin Corse]
Ah, what is it?
Can I help you
with something?
scripts.translation:
[雷丁·科斯]
啊，怎么了？
有什么我可以帮你的吗？

scripts.text:
[Reidin Corse]
You ready? I think it's fair to remind you that I won't tolerate any complaining! Just do what
I say and you'll be the second best Archer in the world! After me, of course~
scripts.translation:
[雷丁·科斯]
准备好了吗？我想提醒你，我不容忍任何抱怨！只要照我说的做，你就会成为世界上第二厉害的弓箭手！当然，第一是我~

scripts.text:
[Reidin Corse]
Ah, you're
finally back.
You've kept me
waiting for a while!
scripts.translation:
[雷丁·科斯]
啊，你终于回来了。
你让我等了好一会儿！

scripts.text:
[Reidin Corse]
Hey! I told
you to learn
Level 3 Owl's Eye!
Try not to learn something
else by accident, okay?
scripts.translation:
[雷丁·科斯]
嘿！我让你学3级鹗枭之眼！
别不小心学了别的技能，好吗？

scripts.text:
[Reidin Corse]
Alright, open
your Skill Window.
Since you have Level 3
Owl's Eye, now you oughta be
able to see the Vulture's Eye
skill in the list too.
scripts.translation:
[雷丁·科斯]
好的，打开你的技能窗口。
既然你有3级鹗枭之眼，现在你应该能在列表里看到苍鹰之眼技能了。

scripts.text:
[Reidin Corse]
Mandagora lives in the area north of Geffen. Learn up to Level 3 Vulture's Eye and get acquainted with your attack range.
scripts.translation:
[雷丁·科斯]
曼达戈拉生活在吉芬北部的区域。学会3级苍鹰之眼，并熟悉你的攻击范围。

scripts.text:
[Reidin Corse]
Mandagora lives in the area north and east of Prontera. Learn up to Level 3 Vulture's Eye and get acquainted with your attack range.
scripts.translation:
[雷丁·科斯]
曼达戈拉生活在普隆德拉北部和东部的区域。学会3级苍鹰之眼，并熟悉你的攻击范围。

scripts.text:
[Reidin Corse]
Ah, so you've learned
a little something about Vulture's Eye! What do you think about it now? Ah, and here's a little reward for you before I start the next lesson~
scripts.translation:
[雷丁·科斯]
啊，看来你学到了一些关于苍鹰之眼的知识！你现在觉得它怎么样？啊，在我开始下一课之前，先给你一点小奖励~

scripts.text:
[Reidin Corse]
Okay...
Up till now we've
studied Passive Skills.
You know, Owl's Eye
and Vulture's Eye.
scripts.translation:
[雷丁·科斯]
好的...
到目前为止，我们学习了被动技能。
也就是鹗枭之眼
和苍鹰之眼。

scripts.text:
[Reidin Corse]
Now, I've taught you a lot of stuff and I wanna make sure you retain all of it. That's why I want you to take this midterm. Your mission: ^FF0000Attack the Rockers^000000!
scripts.translation:
[雷丁·科斯]
现在，我教了你很多东西，我想确保你全都记住了。所以我要你参加这次期中考试。你的任务：^FF0000攻击蝗虫^000000！

scripts.text:
[Reidin Corse]
Hey...
You gotta bring
^3131FF10 Grasshopper's Leg^000000 to pass my midterm! Go back to the southwest area of Prontera and get them!
scripts.translation:
[雷丁·科斯]
嘿...
要通过我的期中考试，你必须带^3131FF10蝗虫后腿^000000来！回到普隆德拉的西南区域去收集吧！

scripts.text:
[Reidin Corse]
Hey...
You gotta bring
^3131FF10 Tentacles^000000 and
^3131FF1 Crystal Blue^000000 to pass my midterm! Go back to the dungeon on Byalan Island and get them!
scripts.translation:
[雷丁·科斯]
嘿...
要通过我的期中考试，你必须带^3131FF10触手^000000和
^3131FF1水灵矿石^000000来！回到拜兰岛的地下城去收集吧！

scripts.text:
[Reidin Corse]
Why are you carrying
so much stuff? You better put everything you don't need into Kafra Storage.
scripts.translation:
[雷丁·科斯]
你身上怎么带了这么多东西？最好把不需要的东西都放进卡普拉仓库。

scripts.text:
[Reidin Corse]
Hey, you're back!
Let's see now...
scripts.translation:
[雷丁·科斯]
嘿，你回来了！
让我看看...

scripts.text:
[Reidin Corse]
Alright, now there's only
one more skill you need to know about. Personally, I think this one is crucial for every Archer...
scripts.translation:
[雷丁·科斯]
好了，现在只剩下
一个技能需要了解了。就我个人而言，我认为这对每个弓箭手来说都至关重要...

scripts.text:
[Reidin Corse]
^333333*Sigh*^000000
It was a pain in the
ass, but we're finally
done with all of your lessons.
scripts.translation:
[雷丁·科斯]
^333333*叹气*^000000
真是让人头疼，
但我们终于
完成了所有的课程。

scripts.text:
[Reidin Corse]
Remember, you
need to head into
the forest east of Payon and get me
^3131FF10 Mushroom Spores^000000
and ^3131FF10 Pointed Scales^000000.
scripts.translation:
[雷丁·科斯]
记住，你需要前往斐扬东边的森林，给我带
^3131FF10香菇芽孢^000000
和 ^3131FF10鳞片梗^000000回来。

scripts.text:
[Reidin Corse]
Remember, you
need to head over to
Mt. Mjolnir and get me
^3131FF5 Maneater Blossoms^000000
and ^3131FF20 Stems^000000.
scripts.translation:
[雷丁·科斯]
记住，你需要前往
雷神之锤山，给我带
^3131FF5噬人树花^000000
和 ^3131FF20茎^000000回来。

scripts.text:
[Reidin Corse]
Ha-ha~!
You look more like
a veteran than a rookie
now! Yeap, I can see it
in your eyes.
scripts.translation:
[雷丁·科斯]
哈哈~！
你现在看起来更像
老手而不是新人了！没错，我从你
的眼神里看出来了。

scripts.text:
[Reidin Corse]
I really like this town.
There's so much lush greenery
and the birds are always singing. Payon really is peaceful.
scripts.translation:
[雷丁·科斯]
我真的很喜欢这个城镇。
这里绿意盎然，
鸟儿总是歌唱。斐扬真的很宁静。

scripts.text:
[Reidin Corse]
I really like this town.
Everything is green and birds singing all around.. such a peaceful place Payon is.
scripts.translation:
[雷丁·科斯]
我真的很喜欢这个城镇。
到处都是绿色，鸟儿在周围歌唱...斐扬真是个宁静的地方。

scripts.text:
[Reidin Corse]
Allow me to introduce myself. I'm the Archer of all Archers, ^3131FFReidin Corse^000000, Master of the Icarus Guild!
scripts.translation:
[雷丁·科斯]
请允许我自我介绍。我是所有弓箭手中的弓箭手，^3131FF雷丁·科斯^000000，伊卡洛斯公会的师父！

scripts.text: Tell me about skills.
scripts.translation: 告诉我关于技能的事。

scripts.text: Er, not really...
scripts.translation: 呃，不太清楚...

scripts.text:
[Reidin Corse]
Huh. So Master
Kavaruk told you
to come to me, eh?
Alright. Okay.
scripts.translation:
[雷丁·科斯]
哦。所以是卡瓦鲁克师父
让你来找我，是吗？
好吧。好的。

scripts.text:
[Reidin Corse]
Huh...?
Alright. You sure
you've got nothing
to ask me? You had
that look, you know?
scripts.translation:
[雷丁·科斯]
嗯...？
好吧。你确定
没有什么要问我的吗？你刚才
那个表情，你知道吗？

scripts.text:
[Reidin Corse]
Fine. I'm an incredibly
busy guy, but I'll make time for you. I'll teach you what I know about Archer skills... On one condition!
scripts.translation:
[雷丁·科斯]
好吧。我虽然是个
非常忙碌的人，但我会为你腾出时间。我会教你我所知道的弓箭手技能... 只有一个条件！

scripts.text:
[Reidin Corse]
From here on out, you gotta
call me ^3131FFChief^000000, got it? Stick with me and you'll become the second best archer in the world! How
about it, kid?
scripts.translation:
[雷丁·科斯]
从现在开始，你必须
叫我^3131FF首领^000000，明白吗？跟着我，你会成为世界上第二厉害的弓箭手！怎么样，小孩？

scripts.text: You got it, Chief!
scripts.translation: 遵命，首领！

scripts.text: Ugh, no thanks~!
scripts.translation: 呃，不用了~！

scripts.text:
[Reidin Corse]
Ho ho!
That's the way to go!
Good good~ Call me Chief
from now on, you hear?
scripts.translation:
[雷丁·科斯]
哈哈！
这就对了！
很好很好~ 从现在开始，
叫我首领，听到了吗？

scripts.text:
[Reidin Corse]
Huh? What kind of attitude
is that? Ah, I get it. You're not mature enough to recognize greatness when it's right
before you.
scripts.translation:
[雷丁·科斯]
哼？这是什么态度？
啊，我明白了。你还不够成熟，
无法认出站在你面前的伟大人物。

scripts.text:
[Reidin Corse]
Don't worry...
When you come crawlin'
back, I'll reconsider
teaching you.
scripts.translation:
[雷丁·科斯]
别担心...
等你爬回来求我的时候，
我会重新考虑教你。

scripts.text:
[Reidin Corse]
Let's see...
How much do you know?
Mmmmmmmmmm...
scripts.translation:
[雷丁·科斯]
让我看看...
你了解多少？
嗯嗯嗯嗯嗯...

scripts.text: ^3355FFReidin Corse narrows his experienced eyes and sizes you up.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF雷丁·科斯眯起他那双经验丰富的眼睛，打量着你。^000000

scripts.text:
[Reidin Corse]
Alright! We got a fresh Archer here! You're lucky you came to me, I'm the best teacher you can find! But let me warn you, I teach at a really fast pace, so try to keep
up. Okay? Good.
scripts.translation:
[雷丁·科斯]
很好！这里有个新晋弓箭手！
你能来找我真是走运，我是你能找到的最好的老师！
但我得警告你，我教学进度很快，
所以试着跟上。好吗？很好。

scripts.text:
[Reidin Corse]
Okay. It looks like you know
some stuff. But even if you're
a little experienced, there's still room for you to learn. So try and keep up, got it?
scripts.translation:
[雷丁·科斯]
好吧。看来你知道一些东西。
但即使你有一点经验，
你仍然有学习空间。所以试着跟上，明白吗？

scripts.text:
[Reidin Corse]
Hey! You're ready to change jobs, aren't you? Don't waste time here and just get a new job already! Eh, or you can ask Master Kavaruk for something to do.
scripts.translation:
[雷丁·科斯]
嘿！你准备好转职了，不是吗？
别在这里浪费时间，直接去转职吧！
呃，或者你可以找卡瓦鲁克大师给你点任务做。

scripts.text:
[Reidin Corse]
Okay, I'm ready to begin the lessons! Come back over here once you've got your bow and arrows and everything else ready, got it?
scripts.translation:
[雷丁·科斯]
好吧，我准备好开始上课了！
等你准备好弓箭和其他装备后，
再回来找我，明白吗？

scripts.text:
[Reidin Corse]
Well, I'm ready to teach whenever you're ready to learn. Come back once your bow and arrows and everything else is ready, alright?
scripts.translation:
[雷丁·科斯]
嗯，我随时准备教学，只要你准备好学习。
等你准备好弓箭和其他装备后，
再回来，好吗？

scripts.text:
[Reidin Corse]
If you don't like it, you can just quit! No reason to stick around
if you can't keep up with the Chief, anyway.
scripts.translation:
[雷丁·科斯]
如果你不喜欢，你可以直接退出！
反正如果你跟不上首领，
也没必要留下来。

scripts.text: Please teach me... Chief!
scripts.translation: 请教我...首领！

scripts.text: I want to quit.
scripts.translation: 我想退出。

scripts.text:
[Reidin Corse]
That's what I'm talkin' about! Yeah! Just trust me and you'll learn almost everything about Archer skills! Let's get started!
scripts.translation:
[雷丁·科斯]
这才对嘛！
没错！只要信任我，
你几乎能学会所有弓箭手技能！
让我们开始吧！

scripts.text: Yes, Chief!
scripts.translation: 是的，首领！

scripts.text:
[Reidin Corse]
Great...!
I like your style!
scripts.translation:
[雷丁·科斯]
很好...！
我喜欢你的风格！

scripts.text:
[Reidin Corse]
Now, open your Skill Window (Alt+S). You oughta be able to see two skills: ^FF0000Owl's Eye^000000 and ^FF0000Double Strafe^000000. First, I'll talk about Owl's Eye.
scripts.translation:
[雷丁·科斯]
现在，打开你的技能窗口 (Alt+S)。
你应该能看到两个技能：^FF0000鹗枭之眼^000000 和 ^FF0000二连矢^000000。
首先，我来谈谈鹗枭之眼。

scripts.text:
[Reidin Corse]
We Archers need to be able to preceive the movements of our targets from far away. Now, even during the night, nothing can escape the eyes of an owl.
scripts.translation:
[雷丁·科斯]
我们弓箭手需要能够
从远处预判目标的移动。
现在，即使在夜晚，
也没有东西能逃脱猫头鹰的眼睛。

scripts.text:
[Reidin Corse]
So we gotta train our vision so that we see the way owls do. Now
if you can't aim at your targets, you'd be horrible at archery, right? You gotta have Accuracy!
scripts.translation:
[雷丁·科斯]
所以我们要训练视力，
像猫头鹰那样观察。
如果你无法瞄准目标，
那你的箭术肯定很差劲，对吧？
你需要拥有精准度！

scripts.text:
[Reidin Corse]
Now, your first assignment
is to learn ^3131FFLevel 3 Owl's Eye^000000!
From Morocc, if you travel south, you can fight Condors for your training.
scripts.translation:
[雷丁·科斯]
现在，你的第一个任务
是学会^3131FF3级鹗枭之眼^000000！
从莫洛克出发，向南走，
你可以打秃鹰来训练。

scripts.text:
[Reidin Corse]
Now, your first assignment
is to learn ^3131FFLevel 3 Owl's Eye^000000!
From Prontera, if you travel south, south and then west, you can fight Condors for your training.
scripts.translation:
[雷丁·科斯]
现在，你的第一个任务
是学会^3131FF3级鹗枭之眼^000000！
从普隆德拉出发，向南，再向南，然后向西，
你可以打秃鹰来训练。

scripts.text:
[Reidin Corse]
Huh. So you already know a little about Owl's Eye already, huh? Well then, I guess I oughta talk about something you don't know about!
scripts.translation:
[雷丁·科斯]
哦。看来你已经
对鹗枭之眼有点了解了，是吗？
那好吧，我想我应该
讲讲你不知道的东西！

scripts.text:
[Reidin Corse]
You can head somewhere
else if you want, but if you don't know any training areas, then
just follow my great advice.
scripts.translation:
[雷丁·科斯]
如果你愿意，可以去别的地方，
但如果你不知道哪里有训练场，
那就听听我这位大师的建议吧。

scripts.text: I'll follow your advice, Chief!
scripts.translation: 我会听从你的建议，首领！

scripts.text: I'll hunt somewhere else...
scripts.translation: 我去别的地方打怪...

scripts.text:
[Reidin Corse]
I'll send you to
Morocc for now,
so don't forget the
directions I gave you.
Travel ^3131FFsouth^000000.
scripts.translation:
[雷丁·科斯]
我现在先送你
去莫洛克，
所以别忘了我告诉你的方向。
向^3131FF南^000000走。

scripts.text:
[Reidin Corse]
I'll send you to
Prontera for now,
so don't forget the
directions I gave you.
Travel ^3131FFsouth^000000, ^3131FFsouth^000000,
and then ^3131FFwest^000000.
scripts.translation:
[雷丁·科斯]
我现在先送你
去普隆德拉，
所以别忘了我告诉你的方向。
向^3131FF南^000000，再向^3131FF南^000000，
然后向^3131FF西^000000。

scripts.text: Leave right away~
scripts.translation: 马上出发~

scripts.text: W-wait, let me get ready!
scripts.translation: 等...等等，让我准备一下！

scripts.text:
[Reidin Corse]
When you struggle
through the hardships
of training, just think
about trying to become as
good as the greatest Archer
ever: me.
scripts.translation:
[雷丁·科斯]
当你努力
克服训练的艰辛时，
想想试着成为
有史以来最伟大的弓箭手：
也就是我。

scripts.text:
[Reidin Corse]
Okay...!
Off you go!
To Morocc!
scripts.translation:
[雷丁·科斯]
好...！
出发吧！
去莫洛克！

scripts.text:
[Reidin Corse]
Okay...!
Off you go!
To Prontera!
scripts.translation:
[雷丁·科斯]
好...！
出发吧！
去普隆德拉！

scripts.text:
[Reidin Corse]
Hm...?
What do you possibly
need to prepare? Alright,
do whatever it is you
need to do...
scripts.translation:
[雷丁·科斯]
嗯...？
你到底需要准备什么？
好吧，
去做你需要做的事吧...

scripts.text:
[Reidin Corse]
Say what...?
Alright, then.
But the next time
you come here, you better
know Level 3 Owl's Eye!
scripts.translation:
[雷丁·科斯]
说什么...？
好吧，那就这样。
但下次你来的时候，
一定要学会3级鹗枭之眼！

scripts.text:
[Reidin Corse]
Huh. Okay.
And here I was
getting ready to
teach you all my
archery secrets!
scripts.translation:
[雷丁·科斯]
哦。好吧。
我还以为
正准备
教你所有的
箭术秘诀呢！

scripts.text:
[Reidin Corse]
Ah, but your eyes look a lot sharper than they used to be.
Here, this is a small, special reward for you.
scripts.translation:
[雷丁·科斯]
啊，但你的眼神看起来
比以前锐利多了。
来，这是给你的
一点特别的奖励。

scripts.text:
[Reidin Corse]
Not bad, but you really should master Owl's Eye. That means
you need to learn it all the way
up to Level 10!
scripts.translation:
[雷丁·科斯]
不错，但你真的应该
精通鹗枭之眼。
也就是说
你需要把它练到
10级！

scripts.text:
[Reidin Corse]
Now, I guess I'll
talk about a different
skill in my next lecture, kay?
Come back when you're ready
to learn something new~
scripts.translation:
[雷丁·科斯]
现在，我想
在下一次讲座中
讲讲另一个技能，好吗？
准备好学新东西时
再回来吧~

scripts.text:
[Reidin Corse]
Now when you think
about vultures, what
exactly comes to mind?
scripts.translation:
[雷丁·科斯]
说到秃鹫，
你脑海中浮现的
具体是什么？

scripts.text: Sharp, precise eyes.
scripts.translation: 锐利、精准的目光。

scripts.text: You, Chief.
scripts.translation: 您，首领。

scripts.text:
[Reidin Corse]
Exactly!
scripts.translation:
[雷丁·科斯]
没错！

scripts.text:
[Reidin Corse]
Hahahaha!
Well, I am famous
for my incredible
vision and precision!
^333333*Ahem*^000000 Anyway...
scripts.translation:
[雷丁·科斯]
哈哈哈哈哈！
没错，我正是以
超凡的视力和精准度
闻名于世的！
^333333*咳咳*^000000 总之...

scripts.text:
[Reidin Corse]
Vultures circle the sky, find a target on the ground, and then very swiftly swoop down and ensnare their prey in their claws.
scripts.translation:
[雷丁·科斯]
秃鹫在天空盘旋，锁定地面上的目标，然后迅速俯冲，用利爪抓住猎物。

scripts.text:
[Reidin Corse]
No doubt about it.
Vultures are awesome!
scripts.translation:
[雷丁·科斯]
毫无疑问。
秃鹫太棒了！

scripts.text:
[Reidin Corse]
The ^3131FFVulture's Eye^000000 skill allows
you to train your vision to be like a vulture's. You'll increase your Attack Accuracy and can target enemies from further away.
scripts.translation:
[雷丁·科斯]
^3131FF苍鹰之眼^000000技能能让你
训练出像秃鹫一样的视力。
这将提升你的攻击命中率，
并且可以锁定更远处的敌人。

scripts.text:
[Reidin Corse]
I know that you can attack
from a distance now, but don't
be satisfied with just your current attack range. Learn Vulture's Eye so you can attack from even further distances.
scripts.translation:
[雷丁·科斯]
我知道你现在
已经可以远程攻击了，
但不要满足于当前的攻击距离。
学会苍鹰之眼，
这样你就能攻击更远的地方。

scripts.text:
[Reidin Corse]
Now for your
second assignment!
Go hunt Mandagora!
Mandagora don't move,
so they're perfect for target
practice from a distance!
scripts.translation:
[雷丁·科斯]
接下来是
你的第二个任务！
去猎杀曼达戈拉！
曼达戈拉不会移动，
所以非常适合
作为远程射击的练习目标！

scripts.text:
Alright, Mandagora usually live around Geffen. I can send you to Geffen, so just travel north from there to find
some of them.
scripts.translation: 好的，曼达戈拉通常生活在吉芬附近。我可以把你送到吉芬，然后你只需向北走就能找到它们。

scripts.text:
Alright, Mandagora usually live around Mt. Mjolnir. I can send you to Prontera, so just travel north, then east from there to find
some of them.
scripts.translation: 好的，曼达戈拉通常生活在雷神之锤山附近。我可以把你送到普隆德拉，然后你只需向北再向东走就能找到它们。

scripts.text:
[Reidin Corse]
Remember, the most
important thing is to level the Vulture's Eye skill and test the distance of your attack range.
scripts.translation:
[雷丁·科斯]
记住，最重要的是
提升苍鹰之眼技能的等级，
并测试你的攻击距离。

scripts.text:
[Reidin Corse]
Remember, the most
important thing is to level the Vulture's Eye skill and test the distance of your attack range.
You've got plenty of arrows
for that, so go for it!
scripts.translation:
[雷丁·科斯]
记住，最重要的是
提升苍鹰之眼技能的等级，
并测试你的攻击距离。
你有很多箭
可以用来练习，所以加油吧！

scripts.text:
[Reidin Corse]
Here's a little something to encourage you. Since Mandagora are Earth property monsters, these Fire Arrows will work really well.
scripts.translation:
[雷丁·科斯]
给你一点小鼓励。
既然曼达戈拉是土属性魔物，
这些火箭矢会非常有效。

scripts.text:
[Reidin Corse]
Alright~
Ready to go?
scripts.translation:
[雷丁·科斯]
好了~
准备好了吗？

scripts.text: Let's go!
scripts.translation: 出发吧！

scripts.text: W-wait a minute!
scripts.translation: 等...等一下！

scripts.text:
[Reidin Corse]
Alright...!
Get a move on!
scripts.translation:
[雷丁·科斯]
好吧...！
快点行动！

scripts.text:
[Reidin Corse]
You still need
to get ready?
Hurry it up!
scripts.translation:
[雷丁·科斯]
你还需要
做准备吗？
快点！

scripts.text:
Eh?
Wait a minute...
scripts.translation:
咦？
等一下...

scripts.text:
[Reidin Corse]
You already
learned Vulture's Eye!
Why did I spend so much time explaining about it? Well, I guess we're ready to move on to the next lesson...
scripts.translation:
[雷丁·科斯]
你已经学会了苍鹰之眼！
我为什么要花那么多时间解释它呢？好吧，我想我们准备好进入下一课了...

scripts.text:
[Reidin Corse]
Okay...
Are you
ready to go?
scripts.translation:
[雷丁·科斯]
好了...
你准备好出发了吗？

scripts.text: Go.
scripts.translation: 出发。

scripts.text: Wait a moment.
scripts.translation: 等一下。

scripts.text:
[Reidin Corse]
Alright...!
Get a move on!
scripts.translation:
[雷丁·科斯]
好吧...！
快点行动！

scripts.text:
[Reidin Corse]
You still need
to get ready?
Hurry it up!
scripts.translation:
[雷丁·科斯]
你还需要
做准备吗？
快点！

scripts.text:
[Reidin Corse]
Even though you may not be doing anything, Passive Skills are always in effect. Now, it's time for me to teach you about an Active Skill
for Archers. Ready?
scripts.translation:
[雷丁·科斯]
即使你什么都没做，被动技能也始终生效。现在，是时候教你弓箭手的主动技能了。准备好了吗？

scripts.text:
[Reidin Corse]
Today I'll tell
you all about
^3131FFDouble Strafe^000000!
Whaddya think?
Exciting, yes?
scripts.translation:
[雷丁·科斯]
今天我要向你介绍^3131FF二连矢^000000！
你觉得怎么样？
很刺激，对吧？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I...
I already know
about Double Strafe.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我...
我已经知道二连矢了。

scripts.text:
[Reidin Corse]
...
......

[Reidin Corse]
^333333*Sigh*^000000
Next lesson...

[Reidin Corse]
Just like its name, Double Strafe allows you to attack enemies with your arrows twice in a row! Booyah~
scripts.translation:
[雷丁·科斯]
顾名思义，二连矢允许你连续用箭攻击敌人两次！万岁~

scripts.text:
[Reidin Corse]
As Double Strafe's level rises, its attack strength also increases. If you master this skill, you can do a great amount of damage to your enemies!
scripts.translation:
[雷丁·科斯]
随着二连矢等级的提升，其攻击力也会增加。如果你掌握了这个技能，就能对敌人造成大量伤害！

scripts.text:
[Reidin Corse]
Hold your bow and arrow
like this, concentrate, aim,
then fire twice with all your
might! Practice Double Strafe
enough and you'll get used to it!
scripts.translation:
[雷丁·科斯]
像这样握住弓和箭，集中精神，瞄准，
然后尽全力射出两箭！
多练习二连矢，你就会习惯的！

scripts.text:
[Reidin Corse]
Now, there's another skill known as ^FF0000Arrow Shower^000000. Where Double Strafe uses 2 Arrows, Arrow Shower fires a bunch of arrows at once.
scripts.translation:
[雷丁·科斯]
现在，还有一个技能叫做^FF0000箭雨^000000。二连矢使用2支箭，而箭雨则是一次射出大量箭矢。

scripts.text:
[Reidin Corse]
Not even I can handle
Arrow Shower all that well since it's really hard. Still, maybe if you trained more at it, you'd manage to pull it off?
scripts.translation:
[雷丁·科斯]
连我自己都很难完全掌握箭雨，因为它真的很难。不过，如果你多练习，也许就能成功施展？

scripts.text:
[Reidin Corse]
Rockers live just southwest of Prontera.
scripts.translation:
[雷丁·科斯]
蝗虫生活在普隆德拉的西南方。

scripts.text:
[Reidin Corse]
Be aware that Rockers are earth element monsters!! ^3131FFSo they should be weak against fire^000000.
scripts.translation:
[雷丁·科斯]
注意，蝗虫是土属性魔物！！^3131FF所以它们应该怕火^000000。

scripts.text:
[Reidin Corse]
Now go and bring ^3131FF10 Grasshopper's Leg^000000 from hunting Rockers.
Bring all of that and you pass~
scripts.translation:
[雷丁·科斯]
现在去狩猎蝗虫，带^3131FF10个蝗虫后腿^000000回来。
带齐这些你就通过了~

scripts.text:
[Reidin Corse]
It's easier to find them if you pass by the southern gate of Prontera and then head west. Alright, off you go, {0}~
scripts.translation:
[雷丁·科斯]
经过普隆德拉的南门然后向西走，更容易找到它们。好了，去吧，{0}~

scripts.text:
[Reidin Corse]
There's a ship that
leads to Byalan Island in Izlude, Prontera's satellite city. Ride that ship to Byalan Island.
scripts.translation:
[雷丁·科斯]
有一艘船通往依斯鲁得岛的拜兰岛，拜兰岛是普隆德拉的卫星城市。乘坐那艘船去拜兰岛。

scripts.text:
[Reidin Corse]
In the center of that island is the entrance to a dungeon where a lot of Hydras live. Remember that it's a water dungeon, and that ^3131FFWater resists Fire^000000, ^3131FFbut is weak against Wind^000000.
scripts.translation:
[雷丁·科斯]
在该岛的中心有一个地下城入口，那里有很多海葵。记住那是一个水属性地下城，^3131FF水属性抵抗火属性^000000，^3131FF但怕风属性^000000。

scripts.text:
[Reidin Corse]
Now go and bring ^3131FF10 Tentacles^000000
from hunting Hydra and ^3131FF1 Crystal Blue^000000, which you can get from hunting the Mushrooms there.
Bring all of that and you pass~
scripts.translation:
[雷丁·科斯]
现在去狩猎海葵，带^3131FF10个触手^000000回来，
还有从那里的蘑菇身上获得的^3131FF1个水灵矿石^000000。
带齐这些你就通过了~

scripts.text:
[Reidin Corse]
It's easier to find Izlude if you pass by Prontera, so head towards the fields near Prontera. Alright, off you go, {0}~
scripts.translation:
[雷丁·科斯]
经过普隆德拉再前往依斯鲁得岛会更容易找到，所以朝着普隆德拉附近的田野方向走吧。好了，去吧，{0}~

scripts.text:
[Reidin Corse]
Good! You pass.
Don't forget that you gotta keep training and improve your skills. Before you know it, you'll be an expert almost as good as me!
scripts.translation:
[雷丁·科斯]
很好！你通过了。
别忘了要持续训练，提升你的技能。不知不觉间，你也会成为像我一样厉害的专家！

scripts.text:
[Reidin Corse]
Open your Skill Window.
Make sure that you learn
^FF0000Increase Concentration^000000.
Now, how can I describe
how to do it?
scripts.translation:
[雷丁·科斯]
打开你的技能窗口。
确保你学会了
^FF0000凝神^000000。
那么，我该怎么描述
这个技能的使用方法呢？

scripts.text:
[Reidin Corse]
I guess that first, you gotta quiet your mind and enter a state of complete concentration. Steadily draw your bowstring back. If there's even a millisecond of imbalance, you'll miss.
scripts.translation:
[雷丁·科斯]
我想首先，你必须静下心来，进入完全专注的状态。稳稳地拉开弓弦。哪怕有一毫秒的失衡，你就会射偏。

scripts.text:
[Reidin Corse]
We use Increase Concentration
to keep ourselves calm and focused to ^3131FFmaximize certain abilities and stats^000000. This skill enhances our performance as Archers immensely!
scripts.translation:
[雷丁·科斯]
我们使用凝神来保持冷静和专注，从而^3131FF最大化特定的能力和属性^000000。这个技能极大地提升了我们弓箭手的表现！

scripts.text:
[Reidin Corse]
You might not be able
to see it now, but as you become more skilled, you'll eventually recognize all the benefits of this skill.
scripts.translation:
[雷丁·科斯]
你现在可能还看不出什么，但随着你变得更强，你最终会认识到这个技能的所有好处。

scripts.text:
[Reidin Corse]
Ah, but it's not time for
you to relax yet! Since I've given you a midterm, it's only fitting that I also give you a final!
scripts.translation:
[雷丁·科斯]
啊，但你还不能放松！既然我给了你期中考试，那我也得给你期末考！

scripts.text:
[Reidin Corse]
Surprised, huh?
Well, this test is a little harder, but I'll help you out so there's
no need for you to fret.
scripts.translation:
[雷丁·科斯]
很惊讶吧？
嗯，这次考试稍微难一点，但我会帮你的，所以不用太担心。

scripts.text:
[Reidin Corse]
Now, go into the forest east of Payon and hunt Spores and Wormtails. Your test will be to bring back ^3131FF10 Mushroom Spores^000000 and
^3131FF10 Pointed Scales^000000.
scripts.translation:
[雷丁·科斯]
现在，去斐扬东边的森林，狩猎魔菇和森灵。你的考试任务是带回^3131FF10个香菇芽孢^000000和
^3131FF10个鳞片梗^000000。

scripts.text:
[Reidin Corse]
Now, go to Mt. Mjolnir and hunt Floras. Your test will be to bring back ^3131FF5 Maneater Blossoms^000000 and
^3131FF20 Stems^000000.
scripts.translation:
[雷丁·科斯]
现在，去雷神之锤山，狩猎芙罗拉。你的考试任务是带回^3131FF5个噬人树花^000000和
^3131FF20个茎^000000。

scripts.text:
[Reidin Corse]
I know it's a little dangerous,
but I've got a pal who'll be there to help you. Of course, she's still in training, but...
scripts.translation:
[雷丁·科斯]
我知道这有点危险，
但我有个朋友会在那里帮你。当然，她还在训练中，但是...

scripts.text:
[Reidin Corse]
Oh...
And one last thing.
Take some of these.
scripts.translation:
[雷丁·科斯]
哦...
还有一件事。
拿一些这个。

scripts.text:
[Reidin Corse]
H-hey!
Why are you carrying
so much stuff? You better put everything you don't need into Kafra Storage.
scripts.translation:
[雷丁·科斯]
嘿！
你为什么带这么多东西？最好把你不需要的东西都放进卡普拉仓库。

scripts.text:
[Reidin Corse]
This stuff is just a little something to encourage you, so don't take it the wrong way! Now hurry up, get what I asked for,
and come back!
scripts.translation:
[雷丁·科斯]
这些只是给你的一点鼓励，别误会了！现在快点，去拿我让你拿的东西，
然后回来！

scripts.text:
[Reidin Corse]
From Prontera, you'd get to Mt. Mjolnir by traveling ^3131FFnorth^000000, ^3131FFnorth^000000 and then ^3131FFeast^000000. But if you want,
I can just send you there.
scripts.translation:
[雷丁·科斯]
从普隆德拉出发，向^3131FF北^000000走，再向^3131FF北^000000，然后向^3131FF东^000000就能到雷神之锤山。但如果你愿意，
我可以直接把你送过去。

scripts.text: Go!
scripts.translation: 去吧！

scripts.text: W-Wait!
scripts.translation: 等等！

scripts.text:
[Reidin Corse]
Alright!
Oh, and if you get
the chance, give a hello to my Acolyte pal over there for me~
scripts.translation:
[雷丁·科斯]
好的！
哦，如果你有机会，帮我向那边的服事朋友问声好~

scripts.text:
[Reidin Corse]
Huh?
Um, sure. But
there's no reason to
get so nervous, even if
this my final exam for you.
scripts.translation:
[雷丁·科斯]
嗯？
嗯，当然。但
即使这是我给你的期末考，
也没必要这么紧张。

scripts.text:
Ha-ha~!
You look more like
a veteran than a rookie
now! Yeap, I can see it
in your eyes.
scripts.translation:
哈哈~！
你现在看起来更像老手，而不是新人了！
没错，我从你的眼神里看出来了。

scripts.text:
[Reidin Corse]
Right, did you get a chance to meet my Acolyte pal, Mafra? She's pretty shy, but I hope you two got along.
scripts.translation:
[雷丁·科斯]
对了，你有机会见到我的服事朋友，玛芙拉吗？她有点害羞，但我希望你们俩相处得不错。

scripts.text:
[Reidin Corse]
I'm happy to tell
you that you've passed
my final exam! Here, take
this little reward!
scripts.translation:
[雷丁·科斯]
很高兴地告诉你，你通过了我的期末考！
拿着，这是给你的小奖励！

scripts.text:
[Reidin Corse]
Well, it's like you're a full fledged Archer now. Honestly,
I've got nothing more to teach you. Well, about archery, anyway.
scripts.translation:
[雷丁·科斯]
嗯，你现在算是个合格的弓箭手了。
说实话，关于射箭，我已经没什么可教你的了。

scripts.text:
[Reidin Corse]
Well, if you talk to him, Master Kavaruk might have something for you to do. He happens to have me running around to doing errands
for him too. That creep!
scripts.translation:
[雷丁·科斯]
嗯，如果你去和他谈谈，卡瓦鲁克大师可能会给你安排点任务。
他老是让我跑腿给他办事。那个家伙！

scripts.text:
[Reidin Corse]
Well, {0},
It'd make me really happy if you get to the point where you develop a true love for the art of archery. I'll see you sometime, okay?
scripts.translation:
[雷丁·科斯]
嗯，{0}，
如果你能真正爱上射箭这门艺术，我会非常开心的。
再见啦，记得常联系哦？

scripts.text:
[Reidin Corse]
Of course, I've got friends here that I can trust with my life. We always argue, but we all want what's best for each other.
scripts.translation:
[雷丁·科斯]
当然，我这里有可以托付性命的挚友。
我们总是吵架，但我们彼此都希望对方过得好。

scripts.text:
[Reidin Corse]
Wouldn't you
agree that it's
wonderful to have
great friends?
scripts.translation:
[雷丁·科斯]
你觉得，拥有这样的好朋友是不是很美好？

scripts.text:
[Reidin Corse]
I feel so happy laying in the grass and looking up at the sky.
scripts.translation:
[雷丁·科斯]
躺在草地上仰望天空，我感到无比幸福。

scripts.text:
[Reidin Corse]
It might also be because I have my trustable friends here with me. Haha.
We always argue, but we care for each other deep down inside.
scripts.translation:
[雷丁·科斯]
也许是因为我有这些值得信赖的朋友在身边。哈哈。
我们总是吵架，但内心深处我们都很在乎彼此。

scripts.text:
[Reidin Corse]
..'friend' is a wonderful word. Don't you agree?
scripts.translation:
[雷丁·科斯]
...“朋友”是个很美好的词。你不觉得吗？

scripts.text: Allow me to introduce myself. I'm the Archer of all Archers, ^3131FFReidin Corse^000000, Master of the Icarus Guild!
scripts.translation: 请允许我自我介绍。我是万箭之弓，^3131FF雷丁·科斯^000000，伊卡洛斯公会的会长！

scripts.text:
[Reidin Corse]
Right now, we're having a special event! The application fee for the Icarus Guild has been slashed by 50%! Join now and there'll be no annual fees!
scripts.translation:
[雷丁·科斯]
现在，我们正在举办特别活动！伊卡洛斯公会的入会费打五折！现在加入，免年费！

scripts.text:
[Reidin Corse]
During our special event, we'll have no job class restrictions!
As an added bonus, all new male members will be introduced to beautiful Dancer girls!
scripts.translation:
[雷丁·科斯]
在特别活动期间，我们没有职业限制！
额外福利：所有新加入的男性成员都将有机会认识美丽的舞娘！

scripts.text:
[Reidin Corse]
And new female members will have the special opportunity to go out on a date with me! Don't miss out!
scripts.translation:
[雷丁·科斯]
而新加入的女性成员将有机会和我约会！千万不要错过！

scripts.text:
[Reidin Corse]
Join right now
for a one time fee of only ^3131FF1,000,000, zeny^000000! Hurry and join the Icarus Guild while
this offer still lasts!
scripts.translation:
[雷丁·科斯]
现在加入，只需一次性支付^3131FF1,000,000 Zeny^000000！
趁优惠还在，赶紧加入伊卡洛斯公会吧！

scripts.text:
[Arpesto]
Reidin...
Stop messing around.
Hey there, kid. The real
master of the Icarus Guild
is in that building.
scripts.translation:
[阿尔佩斯托]
雷丁...
别闹了。
嘿，小孩。伊卡洛斯公会真正的会长在那栋楼里。

scripts.text:
[Reidin Corse]
Arpesto...!
Why'd you...?!
scripts.translation:
[雷丁·科斯]
阿尔佩斯托...！
你...你怎么...？！

scripts.text:
[Reidin Corse]
^333333*Sigh*^000000
You got me, you got me.
There's no application fee.
But I'll still date all of
those cute girls...
scripts.translation:
[雷丁·科斯]
^333333*叹气*^000000
好吧，好吧。
没有入会费。
但我还是会和那些可爱的女孩们约会的...

scripts.text:
[Seisner]
Aaaah!
Double Strafe!
scripts.translation:
[赛斯纳]
啊啊啊！
二连矢！

scripts.text:
[Seisner]
I did it!
Only an Archer
could make that shot!
scripts.translation:
[赛斯纳]
我做到了！
只有弓箭手
才能射出那一箭！

scripts.text:
[Seisner]
Now, there are some
Thief class people who also use arrows, but they're better suited to using Knives. We Archers are
the arrow specialists!
scripts.translation:
[赛斯纳]
现在，虽然有些盗贼职业的人也会使用箭矢，但他们更适合使用匕首。我们弓箭手才是箭矢专家！

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou show Seisner
the letter that Master
Kavaruk has written
to her for you.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你向赛斯纳展示
卡瓦鲁克大师
为你写的那封信。^000000

scripts.text:
[Seisner]
So Master Kavaruk
wants me to teach you
about Archers and Archery? Alright, what would you like to know more about?
scripts.translation:
[赛斯纳]
原来卡瓦鲁克大师
想让我教你
关于弓箭手和射箭的知识？好的，你想了解哪方面？

scripts.text: About Archers.
scripts.translation: 关于弓箭手。

scripts.text: Stats for Archers
scripts.translation: 弓箭手的属性

scripts.text: End Conversation.
scripts.translation: 结束对话。

scripts.text:
[Seisner]
Archers specialize
in shooting ^3131FFarrows^000000. We usually attack from a distance, but before we increase our Dodge Rate, we're pretty weak when it comes to one on one battles.
scripts.translation:
[赛斯纳]
弓箭手擅长射击^3131FF箭矢^000000。我们通常从远处发起攻击，但在提升回避率之前，我们在单挑中比较脆弱。

scripts.text:
[Seisner]
Therefore, Archers tend to attack before the enemy gets too close.
We also like to party with other people who can offer close
range protection.
scripts.translation:
[赛斯纳]
因此，弓箭手倾向于在敌人靠近之前发起攻击。
我们也喜欢与其他能提供近身保护的人组队。

scripts.text:
[Seisner]
Now, only Novices can
become Archers after reaching
Job Level 10 and learning all of the Basic Skills.
scripts.translation:
[赛斯纳]
现在，只有初心者
在达到职业等级10并
学会所有基本技能后，
才能转职为弓箭手。

scripts.text:
[Seisner]
Well experienced Archers can move on and change to the Second Job Class, becoming ^3131FFHunters^000000, ^3131FFBards^000000 if they are male, or ^3131FFDancers^000000 if they are female.
scripts.translation:
[赛斯纳]
经验丰富的弓箭手可以进一步转职为二转职业，男性可以成为^3131FF猎人^000000或^3131FF诗人^000000，女性可以成为^3131FF舞娘^000000。

scripts.text:
[Seisner]
If you reach Level 99
as a Second Job Class character, you can change to a Transcendent Class with Valkyrie's help.
scripts.translation:
[赛斯纳]
如果你作为二转职业角色达到99级，可以在瓦尔基里的帮助下转职为三转职业。

scripts.text:
[Seisner]
Hunters can ultimately transcend into ^3131FFSnipers^000000, Bards into ^3131FFMinstrels^000000, and Dancers into ^3131FFGypsies^000000. I know that's pretty complex.
scripts.translation:
[赛斯纳]
猎人最终可以转职为^3131FF神射手^000000，诗人转职为^3131FF宫廷乐师^000000，舞娘转职为^3131FF吉普赛人^000000。我知道这有点复杂。

scripts.text:
[Seisner]
So you want to
know more about Stats
and how they affect Archer abilities? I'll do my best to explain.
scripts.translation:
[赛斯纳]
所以你想了解更多关于属性
以及它们如何影响弓箭手能力？我会尽力解释。

scripts.text: STR
scripts.translation: 力量

scripts.text: VIT
scripts.translation: 体质

scripts.text: LUK
scripts.translation: 幸运

scripts.text: End Conversation.
scripts.translation: 结束对话。

scripts.text:
[Seisner]
STR typically increases the damage of attacks. However, Archer class characters use weapons that rely on ^FF3131DEX^000000 to increase their damage.
scripts.translation:
[赛斯纳]
STR通常增加攻击伤害。然而，弓箭手职业使用的武器依赖^FF3131DEX^000000来提升伤害。

scripts.text:
[Seisner]
In a sense, STR might not be necessary for Archers, although I'm sure there are skills or situations where STR will come in handy.
scripts.translation:
[赛斯纳]
从某种意义上说，弓箭手可能不需要STR，但我相信有些技能或情况下STR会很有用。

scripts.text:
[Seisner]
For instance, if you run out of arrows (which is every Archer's nightmare) and need to equip a Knife, having some STR might
be helpful.
scripts.translation:
[赛斯纳]
例如，如果你箭矢用完了（这是每个弓箭手的噩梦）并且需要装备匕首，拥有一些STR可能会有帮助。

scripts.text:
[Seisner]
Increasing STR will also
increase the amount of weight
that any character can carry. So if you have more STR, you can carry around more arrows.
scripts.translation:
[赛斯纳]
增加STR也会增加
角色可以携带的重量。所以如果你有更多的STR，你可以携带更多的箭矢。

scripts.text:
[Seisner]
^FF3131AGI^000000 as you know, 
^3131Ffincreases Attack Speed
(ASPD)^000000 and affects ^3131FF Dodge Rate^000000.
scripts.translation:
[赛斯纳]
^FF3131AGI^000000如你所知，
^3131Ff提升攻击速度
(ASPD)^000000，并影响^3131FF闪避率^000000。

scripts.text:
[Seisner]
One of the drawbacks of being an Archer is having weaker strength and lower Dodge Rate. However, the Dodge Rate disadvantage is lessened by increasing your ^FF3131AGI^000000.
scripts.translation:
[赛斯纳]
作为弓箭手的一个缺点是力量较弱且闪避率较低。不过，通过提升^FF3131AGI^000000可以减轻闪避率上的劣势。

scripts.text:
[Seisner]
^3131FFVIT^000000 will increase
your Maximum HP and
resistance to damage.
scripts.translation:
[赛斯纳]
^3131FFVIT^000000会提升
你的最大HP
以及对伤害的抗性。

scripts.text:
[Seisner]
Although Archers don't
specialize in having any special kind of defense, having VIT will help alleviate the defensive weakness of the Archer class.
scripts.translation:
[赛斯纳]
虽然弓箭手并不以某种特殊的防御见长，但提升VIT有助于弥补弓箭手职业在防御上的弱点。

scripts.text:
[Seisner]
VIT might be helpful
depending on how you use it. Still, I wouldn't recommend focusing too much on increasing your VIT if you're an Archer.
scripts.translation:
[赛斯纳]
VIT是否有帮助取决于你的用法。不过，如果你是弓箭手，我不太建议你过度专注于提升VIT。

scripts.text:
[Seisner]
^FF0000INT^000000 is more
important to the
Archer class than
you would think~
scripts.translation:
[赛斯纳]
^FF0000INT^000000对弓箭手职业
的重要性
比你想象的要高~

scripts.text:
[Seisner]
As you increase ^FF0000INT^000000, you'll raise your Maximum SP, meaning you
can use special skills more often.
scripts.translation:
[赛斯纳]
随着^FF0000INT^000000的提升，你的最大SP也会增加，
这意味着你可以更频繁地使用特殊技能。

scripts.text:
[Seisner]
For Hunters, one of the Second Job Classes for Archers, having higher INT will increase the damage inflicted by ^3131FFFalcons^000000.
scripts.translation:
[赛斯纳]
对于猎人（弓箭手的二转职业之一）来说，较高的INT会增加^3131FFFalcon^000000造成的伤害。

scripts.text:
[Seisner]
Now DEX is almost
without a doubt the
most important stat
for any Archer.
scripts.translation:
[赛斯纳]
现在，DEX几乎可以确定
是任何弓箭手
最重要的属性。

scripts.text:
[Seisner]
^FF3131DEX^000000 ^3131Ffincreases the damage^000000
of Archer class weapons that fire arrows. These include ^3131FFBows^000000, ^3131FFInstruments^000000 and ^3131FFWhips^000000.

[Seisner]
Dexterity enhances an Archer's ability to hit weak points and do more damage, which is why weapons that use arrows don't rely on STR like weapons used by other classes.
scripts.translation:
[赛斯纳]
敏捷提升了弓箭手击中弱点并造成更多伤害的能力，这就是为什么使用箭矢的武器不像其他职业的武器那样依赖STR。

scripts.text:
[Seisner]
Just like any other class, ^FF3131DEX^000000 increases ^3131FFAccuracy (HIT)^000000 and slightly enhances Attack Speed (ASPD).
scripts.translation:
[赛斯纳]
就像其他职业一样，^FF3131DEX^000000提升^3131FF命中率(HIT)^000000，并略微提升攻击速度(ASPD)。

scripts.text:
[Seisner]
^FF0000LUK^000000 affects your
Perfect Dodge rate
and Critical rate.
scripts.translation:
[赛斯纳]
^FF0000LUK^000000影响你的
完美闪避率
和暴击率。

scripts.text:
[Seisner]
For Hunters, one of the Second Classes for the Archer, LUK increases the chance of ^3131FFBlitz Beat^000000 occurring automatically. So Hunters who rely on their Falcons might want to invest in LUK.
scripts.translation:
[赛斯纳]
对于弓箭手的二转职业猎人来说，LUK会增加^3131FF闪电冲击^000000自动触发的几率。所以依赖Falcon的猎人可能会想投资LUK。

scripts.text:
[Seisner]
So is there
anything else that
you want to ask me?
scripts.translation:
[赛斯纳]
那么，还有
什么你想问我的
吗？

scripts.text:
[Seisner]
Once an Archer shoots an arrow,
he can't stop its flight or change his target. That's why Archers need to be level headed and really careful in battle.
scripts.translation:
[赛斯纳]
一旦弓箭手射出箭矢，
他就无法停止其飞行或改变目标。因此，弓箭手在战斗中需要保持冷静并格外小心。

scripts.text:
[Seisner]
Someday, I'd like to become a great Archer and use my skills for the good of Rune-Midgarts.
scripts.translation:
[赛斯纳]
总有一天，我想成为一名伟大的弓箭手，并运用我的技能为卢恩·米德加兹的福祉服务。

scripts.text:
[Seisner]
Thanks for listening.
I know I gave you a lot of information, but I think it's important that everyone
understands archery.
scripts.translation:
[赛斯纳]
谢谢你的倾听。
我知道我给了你很多信息，但我认为每个人都应该了解射箭。

scripts.text:
[Seisner]
If you feel comfortable enough with the knowledge I've taught you, you should go back to Master Kavaruk. But if you still have questions, you can always come and ask me.
scripts.translation:
[赛斯纳]
如果你觉得我已经教给你的知识让你感到足够自信，你应该回到卡瓦鲁克大师那里。但如果你还有疑问，随时可以来问我。

scripts.text:
[Acolyte]
H-hello!
Umm, umm...
Are you R-Reidin Corse's
friend t-too?
scripts.translation:
[服事]
嗨...你好！
嗯，那个...
你也是雷丁·科斯
的朋友吗？

scripts.text:
[Acolyte]
^666666Zzzzz...^000000
Wh-wha...?
Who are you?

[Acolyte]
Okay~!
Let me try
casting a spell
to help you! Yaa~p!
scripts.translation:
[服事]
好~！
让我试着
施展一个法术
来帮帮你吧！耶~！

scripts.text:
[Acolyte]
...
W-why does
traveling make
me sooo sleepy...?
^666666Zzzzzzzz...^000000

[Acolyte]
M-my name is Mafra.
Ever since he saved my life, Reidin has a-always been a good f-friend to me. He's such a great Archer
and a really nice person!
scripts.translation:
[服事]
我...我叫玛芙拉。
自从他救了我的命，雷丁就一直是我...我最好的朋友。他是个很棒的弓箭手，
而且人真的很好！

scripts.text:
[Acolyte]
Um, and...
Uh... Oh no~
What am I supposed
t-to tell you...?
scripts.translation:
[服事]
那个，还有...
呃...糟糕~
我该跟你说点什...什么好呢...？

scripts.text:
[Acolyte]
Oh, since I'm training to be an Acolyte, I'm supposed to help out the people he's teaching. So...
Let's h-help each other train!
Um, is that okay?
scripts.translation:
[服事]
哦，既然我正在接受服事的训练，我应该要帮助他教导的人。所以...
让我们互相帮...帮忙训练吧！
嗯，这样可以吗？

scripts.text: Sure.
scripts.translation: 当然。

scripts.text: No thanks.
scripts.translation: 不用了，谢谢。

scripts.text: Reidin Corse is mine!
scripts.translation: 雷丁·科斯是我的！

scripts.text:
[Acolyte]
Wow!
Thank you, thank you!
I''ll try my very best!
scripts.translation:
[服事]
哇！
谢谢你，谢谢你！
我会尽我最大的努力的！

scripts.text:
[Acolyte]
Oh... Oh.
I'm so sorry.
If you don't need
my help, I guess
that's alright...
scripts.translation:
[服事]
啊...啊。
真对不起。
如果你不需要
我的帮助，那...那也没关系...

scripts.text:
[Acolyte]
Eh?!
R-really?
I guess he doesn't
need to tell me if
he already has a girlfriend...
scripts.translation:
[服事]
诶？！
真...真的吗？
看来他不需要告诉我，
因为他已经有女朋友了...

scripts.text:
[Acolyte]
And he's so brave
and funny and smart.
Y-you're lucky to have him.
^333333*Sniff*^000000 I... I...
scripts.translation:
[服事]
而且他很勇敢，
又有趣又聪明。
你...你真幸运能拥有他。
^333333*吸鼻子*^000000 我...我...

scripts.text:
[Acolyte]
W-wait!
Y-you're a man!
D-d-d-don't tease me
like that! I'm serious!
scripts.translation:
[服事]
等...等一下！
你...你是个男人！
别...别那样捉弄我！我是认真的！

scripts.text:
[Acolyte]
^333333*Sniffle*^000000
I'll d-do my best to help you!
I wish you both happiness! (Waaaaaah~!)
scripts.translation:
[服事]
^333333*抽泣*^000000
我会尽我所能帮助你的！
祝你们幸福！（哇啊啊啊~！）

scripts.text:
[Acolyte]
Wait, I know...
Y-you're... ^666666*Yawn*^000000
So sleepy. Take this for now...

[Acolyte]
Reidin Corse?
I can't believe
I feel asleep fo--
^666666Zzzzzzz...^000000
scripts.translation:
[服事]
雷丁·科斯？
我不敢相信
我竟然睡着了...--
^666666呼噜噜噜...^000000

scripts.text:
[Acolyte]
^666666Zzzz^000000--Oooh!
J-just take this before
I fall asleep again~! ^666666*Yawn*^000000

...
W-why does
traveling make
me sooo sleepy...?
^666666Zzzzzzzz...^000000

[Alchemist Guildmember]
Great...!
I've been waiting
for the Icarus Guild
to send somebody
to help us! Finally!
scripts.translation:
[炼金术士公会成员]
太好了...！
我一直在等
伊卡洛斯公会
派人来帮我们！终于来了！

scripts.text:
[Alchemist Guildmember]
I don't know if you've heard
from Kavaruk, but our Flora field is getting ruined by stray cats.
scripts.translation:
[炼金术士公会成员]
我不知道你有没有从卡瓦鲁克那里听到，但我们的芙罗拉田地被流浪猫破坏了。

scripts.text:
[Alchemist Guildmember]
^666666*Sigh...*^000000
Isn't anyone coming
to help us? We're facing
a really huge crisis here!
scripts.translation:
[炼金术士公会成员]
^666666*叹气...*^000000
没有人来帮我们吗？我们正面临
一场巨大的危机！

scripts.text:
[Alchemist Guildmember]
Would you like to sell ^3131FFStems^000000
and ^3131FFManeater Blossoms^000000 to
the Alchemist Guild? We'll buy
each Stem for ^3131FF30 Zeny^000000 and each
Maneater Blossom for ^3131FF130 Zeny^000000.
scripts.translation:
[炼金术士公会成员]
您是否愿意将^3131FF茎^000000和^3131FF噬人树花^000000卖给炼金术士公会？
我们会以每根茎^3131FF30 Zeny^000000、每朵噬人树花^3131FF130 Zeny^000000的价格收购。

scripts.text: Sell all Stems and Maneater Blossoms
scripts.translation: 出售所有茎和噬人树花

scripts.text: Don't sell anything.
scripts.translation: 什么都不卖

scripts.text:
[Alchemist Guildmember]
Thank you very much!
This will really help
us in maintaining our
Flora field! I really
appreciate your help~
scripts.translation:
[炼金术士公会成员]
非常感谢！
这对我们维护芙罗拉田帮助很大！
真的很感激您的帮助~

scripts.text:
[Alchemist Guildmember]
Seriously...
I'm on the verge of begging!
The Alchemist Guild really needs lots of new supplies to keep our Flora field running!
scripts.translation:
[炼金术士公会成员]
说真的...
我简直要开口求你了！
炼金术士公会急需大量新物资来维持芙罗拉田的运作！

scripts.text:
[Alchemist Guildmember]
No matter how much we chase
them away, they always manage to come back. We really have no choice but to replace what they destroy.
scripts.translation:
[炼金术士公会成员]
无论我们怎么驱赶它们，它们总是设法回来。
我们别无选择，只能替换被它们破坏的部分。

scripts.text:
[Alchemist Guildmember]
We'll reward you if you can bring us ^3131FFStems^000000 and ^3131FFManeater Blossoms^000000
to help us in our field maintenance efforts. These Flora are crucial since they provide funds for our guild. Without them...
scripts.translation:
[炼金术士公会成员]
如果您能带来^3131FF茎^000000和^3131FF噬人树花^000000帮助我们维护田地，我们会给您奖励。
这些芙罗拉至关重要，因为它们为公会提供资金。如果没有它们...

scripts.text:
^666666*Sigh...*^000000
Isn't anyone coming
to help us? We're facing
a really huge crisis here!
scripts.translation:
^666666*叹气...*^000000
没有人来帮我们吗？
我们正面临一场巨大的危机！

scripts.text:
[Arthail]
I am the Bard
who sings only for
himself. The gentle
breeze is the only
audience I have.
scripts.translation:
[阿尔塞尔]
我是只为
自己歌唱的诗人。
微风是我
唯一的听众。

scripts.text:
[Arthail]
I see...
Nothing much.
Another person
found an Emperium
and is starting a
brand new guild...
scripts.translation:
[阿尔塞尔]
原来如此...
没什么大事。
又有人找到了华丽金属，
正在组建一个全新的公会...

scripts.text:
[Arthail]
Where did you go?
I thought you might have been kidnapped since you weren't
here when I woke up.
scripts.translation:
[阿尔塞尔]
你去哪了？
我醒来时你不在这里，
还以为你被绑架了呢。

scripts.text:
[Arthail]
I'm ashamed to ask,
but would you go the fountain in Prontera's central plaza and see
if there's any news?
scripts.translation:
[阿尔塞尔]
我很不好意思开口，
但你能去普隆德拉中央广场的喷泉那里，
看看有没有什么消息吗？

scripts.text:
[Arthail]
I am Arthail
of the Wind.
I sing for no man,
so you had best be on
your way. I'm sorry, but
I have no songs to share.
scripts.translation:
[阿尔塞尔]
我是风的阿尔塞尔。
我不为任何人歌唱，
所以你最好还是走吧。
抱歉，我没有歌可以分享。

scripts.text: Master Kavaruk told me to find you!
scripts.translation: 卡瓦鲁克大师让我来找你！

scripts.text:
[Arthail]
Really now?
I suppose it
can't be helped.
I really should
have contacted him.
scripts.translation:
[阿尔塞尔]
真的吗？
看来
没办法了。
我本该
联系他的。

scripts.text:
[Arthail]
However, I'm very tired from the long trip. I'm exhausted from the crowding of this city and the hundreds of talking people.
I can't handle it all...
scripts.translation:
[阿尔塞尔]
不过，长途跋涉让我非常疲惫。这座城市的拥挤和数百个说话的人让我精疲力竭。
我应付不了这一切...

scripts.text:
[Arthail]
Why can't I be like everyone else? It seems that as I approach people, my heart retreats further away from them. I wonder why that is?
scripts.translation:
[阿尔塞尔]
为什么我不能像其他人一样？
似乎每当我接近别人，我的心就离他们更远。我不知道这是为什么？

scripts.text:
[Arthail]
I became a Bard to try to fix this social complex of mine, but to
no avail. Still, I feel much more at ease when I sing. Ah, but I've said too much already.
scripts.translation:
[阿尔塞尔]
我成为诗人是为了试图克服这种社交障碍，但无济于事。不过，当我唱歌时，我感觉轻松多了。啊，我好像说得太多了。

scripts.text:
[Arthail]
Master Kavaruk
asked you to help
me? Well then, I have
a favor to ask of you.
scripts.translation:
[阿尔塞尔]
卡瓦鲁克大师让你来帮我？
既然这样，我有件事想拜托你。

scripts.text:
[Arthail]
Here in the capital of the
Rune-Midgarts Kingdom, there's supposed to be a fountain in the central plaza. Everyone seems to stop and chat over there.
scripts.translation:
[阿尔塞尔]
在卢恩·米德加兹王国的首都，中央广场上据说有一座喷泉。
大家都喜欢在那里停下来聊天。

scripts.text:
[Arthail]
However, I have a fear of other people and I can't bring myself to go near the crowds of people there. It's embarassing for me to admit this as a Bard...
scripts.translation:
[阿尔塞尔]
但是，我害怕与人接触，根本不敢靠近那里的人群。
作为一名诗人，承认这一点让我很尴尬...

scripts.text:
[Arthail]
Would you please go and see if there's any news being spread around in that area for me?
scripts.translation:
[阿尔塞尔]
能麻烦你去那里看看，有没有什么消息在流传吗？

scripts.text:
[Arthail]
^3131FFEmperium^000000...
There are a lot of ambitious people in Morocc that want one of those. Even in my hometown of Payon,
there are people clamoring to obtain one...
scripts.translation:
[阿尔塞尔]
^3131FF华丽金属^000000...
摩洛克有很多野心勃勃的人想要得到它。甚至在我的家乡斐扬，
也有很多人渴望获得它...

scripts.text:
[Arthail]
Supposedly, having an Emperium
will give you the power to change the world. People are bound to be attracted to it.
scripts.translation:
[阿尔塞尔]
据说，拥有华丽金属就能获得改变世界的力量。
人们自然会被它吸引。

scripts.text:
[Arthail]
Hmm...?
I sense something
dark and ominous...
I wonder what it could be?
scripts.translation:
[阿尔塞尔]
嗯...？
我感觉到某种黑暗而阴森的气息...
不知道那会是什么？

scripts.text:
[Arthail]
I'm probably just stressed and exhausted. I'll feel better once
I get some rest. Would you like to join me and listen to the flowing water?
scripts.translation:
[阿尔塞尔]
我大概只是太紧张和疲惫了。
休息一下就会好多了。你想和我一起听听流水声吗？

scripts.text:
[Arthail]
It's not the greatest feeling if you stay here for too long, but the sound of this water reminds me of home. Did you see the lake by the Icarus Guild? These waters remind me of that place.
scripts.translation:
[阿尔塞尔]
在这里待太久感觉并不好，但这流水声让我想起了家乡。
你看到伊卡洛斯公会旁边的湖了吗？这水让我想起了那个地方。

scripts.text:
[Arthail]
^333333*Yawn...*^000000
I haven't talked
like this in so long.
I'm so tired, I think
I'll rest just a little...
scripts.translation:
[阿尔塞尔]
^333333*打哈欠...*^000000
我已经很久没有这样聊天了。
我太累了，想稍微休息一下...

scripts.text:
^3355FFArthail of the Wind
has fallen fast asleep.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF风之阿尔塞尔
已经沉沉睡去。^000000

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Ah...
So peaceful~
^3355FFThe rhythm of the lapping waters gently eases you into a state of perfect relaxation. The cold, crisp water would feel so refreshing if you dipped your feet into it...^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF潺潺的流水声轻柔地让你进入一种完全放松的状态。如果将双脚浸入冰冷清澈的水中，一定会感到无比清爽...^000000

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Huh?
What was
that noise?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
咦？
刚才那是什么声音？

scripts.text:
[????]
AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAHHHHHHHHHHH!!!!!

[{0}]
What the--?!
That sounds like
screams coming from
inside Prontera Castle!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
什么--？！
那听起来像是
从普隆德拉王宫里面传出的尖叫声！

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou try to wake Arthail
but he's deeply asleep
and won't budge at all.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你试图叫醒阿尔塞尔，
但他睡得很沉，怎么叫都叫不醒。^000000

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I can't help it then.
I'd better go check
this out on my own.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
没办法了。
我还是自己去查看一下吧。

scripts.text:
[Arthail]
So everyone said nothing
happened when you asked
about the shrieks you heard?
That's really peculiar...
scripts.translation:
[阿尔塞尔]
所以大家都说，当你询问那些尖叫声时，什么也没发生？
这真的很奇怪...

scripts.text:
[Arthail]
Even the Emperium you mentioned earlier. I thought it was supposed to be a rare item, but why is it so easy for so many people to get
one? It's very strange...
scripts.translation:
[阿尔塞尔]
还有你之前提到的华丽金属。我以为那是稀有物品，但为什么这么多人能轻易获得？这非常蹊跷...

scripts.text:
[Arthail]
Huh. I better investigate this
a little more, so I'll stay here to gather more information. For now, you should head back to Payon and let Master Kavaruk know that I'm doing alright.
scripts.translation:
[阿尔塞尔]
嗯。我最好再调查一下，所以我会留在这里收集更多信息。现在，你应该回斐扬，告诉卡瓦鲁克大师我没事。

scripts.text:
[Arthail]
And one day...
I guess I'll finally
have a song that
I can share with you.
scripts.translation:
[阿尔塞尔]
总有一天...
我想我终于
能有一首
可以与你分享的歌了。

scripts.text:
[New Guild Master]
Hearken, all
of you who seek
fame and glory!
scripts.translation:
[新任公会会长]
听好了，
所有追求
名声与荣耀的人！

scripts.text:
[New Guild Master]
I hold in my hand this ^3131FFEmperium^000000, sign that I am favored by destiny! Brave ones, I bid you, lend me
your power!
scripts.translation:
[新任公会会长]
我手中握着这块^3131FF华丽金属^000000，这是命运眷顾我的证明！勇敢的战士们，我命令你们，将力量借给我！

scripts.text:
[New Guild Master]
Nothing can stop us!
So long as this jewel
is in my possession,
those who call themselves
my comrades will never
know the taste of defeat!
scripts.translation:
[新任公会会长]
没有什么能阻挡我们！
只要这块宝石
在我手中，
那些自称
我同志的人
将永远不会
尝到失败的滋味！

scripts.text:
[Mage]
Did you see that
new guild master?
Talk about getting
on your soapbox!
scripts.translation:
[魔法师]
你看到那个
新任公会会长了吗？
真是爱说大话啊！

scripts.text:
[Mage]
Doesn't he know that there
are a lot of famous guilds around nowadays? Why would anyone want
to join his small no-name guild?
scripts.translation:
[魔法师]
他难道不知道
现在有很多著名的公会吗？为什么会有人
想加入他那个不知名的小公会？

scripts.text:
[Mage]
Now, if I become a Wizard,
I'm going to join the best guild around. Casting spells to help the strongest Knights and the most powerful Priests would make me
look really cool!
scripts.translation:
[魔法师]
现在，如果我成为巫师，
我要加入最好的公会。施法帮助最强的骑士和最强大的牧师，那看起来一定很酷！

scripts.text:
[Mage]
Bwahahah!
Just thinking
about it makes
me so excited!
scripts.translation:
[魔法师]
哇哈哈！
光是想想
就让我
兴奋不已！

scripts.text:
[Minister]
The royal family
is extremely busy
at the moment, handling
our nation's administration.
scripts.translation:
[大臣]
王室目前
非常忙碌，
正在处理
国家的政务。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I heard screams
from outside! Did
something happen?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我听到外面
有尖叫声！
发生什么事了吗？

scripts.text:
[Minister]
...
......

[Minister]
Ah, there are a few stray cats running around, those Wild Roses, so those noises you heard must have been them. Everything is fine here in the palace.
scripts.translation:
[大臣]
啊，有几只流浪猫在附近乱跑，那些狂暴野猫，所以你听到的声音一定是它们发出的。王宫里一切正常。

scripts.output:
^3355FF大臣先前表现出的紧迫感，
此刻已化作一种冰冷的严厉。
无论你怎么追问，
他恐怕都不会透露更多消息了。^000000
scripts.text:
^3355FFThe urgency that the Minister expressed earlier has been
replaced with a stone cold feeling of sternness. He probably won't tell you much more information,
no matter how much you ask him.

[{0}]
Um...
I hear that
the royal family
might be in sort of
trouble. Is there any
way I could help?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
那个...
我听说
王室可能
遇到了一些麻烦。有没有
什么办法我能帮上忙？

scripts.text:
[Minister]
...
......

[Minister]
You must be mistaken.
The royal family is fine,
especially since our
kingdom is at peace.
scripts.translation:
[大臣]
你一定是搞错了。
王室很好，
尤其是我们的
王国正处于和平时期。

scripts.text:
[Minister]
Perhaps you've gotten that idea because it's very difficult to meet any member of the royal family. Please understand that they're
all very busy trying to serve
the people.
scripts.translation:
[大臣]
也许你会有这种想法，是因为很难见到王室的任何成员。请理解，他们都非常忙碌，正在努力服务人民。

scripts.text:
[Minister]
As a holy servant, I'm sure that you'll find plenty of other people who have need of your help and abilities outside of the palace.
scripts.translation:
[大臣]
作为神圣的侍者，我相信你会在王宫之外找到许多需要你的帮助和能力的人。

scripts.text:
[Minister]
Contact the
Prontera Church.
Hurry, this is urgent!
scripts.translation:
[大臣]
联系普隆德拉教会。
快，情况紧急！

scripts.text:
[Bishop Maugins]
Greetings.
I doubt that you're here to change to the Monk job, but may I help you with something? Perhaps you're
here for a confession?
scripts.translation:
[主教 莫金斯]
你好。
我想你并不是来转职为武僧的，有什么我可以帮你的吗？
或许你是来做告解的？

scripts.text:
[Bishop Maugins]
I'm sorry, but I have
some pressing matter
to think about right now.
Would you come back later?
scripts.translation:
[主教 莫金斯]
抱歉，我现在正有一些紧急事务需要思考。
请稍后再来好吗？

scripts.text:
[Bishop Maugins]
Hm? Work related to
the Palace? Yes, I'm in
charge of that area. So
how may I help you?
scripts.translation:
[主教 莫金斯]
嗯？与王宫有关的工作？
是的，我负责那个区域。
那么，有什么我可以帮你的吗？

scripts.text: Has something happened to the Kingdom?
scripts.translation: 王国发生什么事了吗？

scripts.text: Nothing.
scripts.translation: 没什么。

scripts.text:
[Bishop Maugins]
...!!
scripts.translation:
[主教 莫金斯]
...!!

scripts.text:
[Bishop Maugins]
...
......

[Bishop Maugins]
Ho ho~
Of course not!
The king and I regularly write to each other, but I haven't heard of anything in particular. Please don't worry yourself.
scripts.translation:
[主教 莫金斯]
呵呵~
当然没有！
我和国王经常通信，但我没有听说有什么特别的事情。请不要担心。

scripts.text:
[Bishop Maugins]
Good luck on
your journeys,
brave adventurer.
scripts.translation:
[主教 莫金斯]
祝你在旅途中好运，
勇敢的冒险者。
